name: Crank-operation qualifier
summary: This qualifier identifies manual operation through a crank mechanism.
description: This qualifier identifies manual operation through a crank mechanism. A crank supplies manual mechanical movement to a mechanism that may require several turns or a particular travel. Its role is different from a momentary electrical command to a motor drive.

The schematic records the operating method; the equipment instructions describe actual travel and operating procedure. Indicate any separate position switch rather than assuming the crank mark includes feedback.
readingNotes: Document the mechanism being moved and its travel or operating positions.
A crank-operated mechanism is not automatically a motor-driven mechanism.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Document the mechanism being moved and its travel or operating positions.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: A crank-operated mechanism is not automatically a motor-driven mechanism.
